structured.approach: I read feat.tasks to find the Backend tasks: TSK-05 and TSK-06, both in ap_aging. org.permission_table is restricted and passed by reference only, so I used the permission-table tool view (tool:repo-access) for it. To check that view against the code, I read aging.py, ci.py, CLAUDE.md and .git/config in the ap_aging checkout and searched it for environment, credential and network-import patterns. There were no matches. Both tasks are pure functions with no transport, so no secret is needed or granted and I raised no access request. I removed the statement about git push credentials, because no input supports it. I also marked the re-entry advice as agent judgement and cite only what feat.tasks states. I did not use the connectors, because the inputs held all the facts.

claims.text: No secrets are required for ap_aging and none are granted (permission table).
The Backend tasks are TSK-05 (STORY-05) and TSK-06 (STORY-06), both in ap_aging.
TSK-05 adds the pure function overdue_with_risk(invoices, as_of, risk_by_vendor). TSK-06 adds overdue_rows_to_json(rows) and must not add a transport layer, because one would re-trigger DES-01.
aging.py imports only datetime, decimal and typing, and reads no environment variable, file or network resource.
CI runs locally with the standard library plus coverage. SonarQube is not available locally.
The repository's language is Python 3.9 (standard library).
acme-llm is touched only by TSK-04 in ap_forecast. overdue_with_risk receives the vendor risk as its risk_by_vendor argument.

structured.summary: I rewrote task.secrets_scope.md for FEAT-ZD-48600. The Backend tasks (TSK-05 and TSK-06 in ap_aging) need no secrets in any environment, and none are granted, so no access request was raised. This matches the permission table, the code (aging.py is pure standard-library code and CI needs no credential) and the task scope, which allows no transport layer. The acme-llm provider belongs to the Data Science lane (TSK-04). The statement about git credentials, which no input supported, is gone. Nothing blocks this step.
